description: Get aggregated event counts for a time window. Returns total events, failure count broken down by error category, counts by event category (post, inbox, account, api, webhook), inbox breakdown (comment vs DM vs mention), and the plan's retention window in days. Use to check system health, recent failures, or inbox activity volume.

from.description: RFC3339 start time for the summary window (e.g. 2026-04-10T00:00:00Z). Defaults to 24 hours ago.

to.description: RFC3339 end time. Defaults to now.

name: social_api_events_summary
title: Get Events Summary
